subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Vantage — bake-off status + a distribution risk
body:
Hi both,

Status: Bilal's harness is done and the first bake-off pass ran over the weekend — full bitrate ladders for all three encoders across the mucped23 sources plus Oyin's 2,400-image serving sample. Directionally the public-data result holds on our corpus: at matched perceptual quality, jpegli comes in around 12–14% smaller than MozJPEG in the mid-quality range where most of our traffic sits, and libjpeg-turbo trails both on quality-per-byte (as expected — it optimizes for speed).

The risk: our serving sample is much heavier on text-in-image and UI screenshots than the CID22-style photographic sources, and on that slice the jpegli advantage shrinks to ~5% with occasional ringing around high-contrast text that the metrics under-penalize. This is exactly the distribution-mismatch trap mucped23 warns about with legacy IQA databases, just one level up.

Recommendation: spend the $12k on the human confirmation batch, weighted toward the text-heavy slice. Without it I can't sign a switch recommendation for all traffic.

Yusuf
